event_chain.summary: Evil-twin network serves credential phishing page

summary: On Delta Flight 591 from Las Vegas to Atlanta on August 10, 2026, passengers returning from the DEF CON conference set up a rogue Wi-Fi network called "Delta WiFi Fast" and jammed the aircraft's real in-flight Wi-Fi, according to crew messages to Delta corporate security. Unverified reports said the attackers used a Wi-Fi Pineapple to clone the network and serve phishing pages that harvested passengers' Google credentials. The crew disabled Wi-Fi for part of the flight; Delta said aircraft systems and flight safety were not affected and that it was investigating with federal law enforcement.
